scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Overdamped, one-dimensional, symmetric telegraph propulsion; fixed trap/tumble parameters and positive thermal diffusion. The convolution and curvature threshold are prior work. Novelty concerns modal uniqueness, threshold monotonicity and explicit universal peak-splitting coefficient; possible implicit general coverage remains. Verification is analytic with finite diagnostics; no independent validation.
title: Universal square-root splitting and exact modality of thermally smoothed trapped run-and-tumble laws
